Tabs ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

When to use it ​

Switch between related views, or use ASAM data items to show labels and counts.

Basic usage and states ​

This example uses the component's public API.

Example: basic

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamTabs
		:model-value="active"
		:items="items"
		@update:model-value="
			(value) => {
				if (typeof value === 'string') active = value;
			}
		"
		@change="changes++"
	>
		<template #label="{ item }">{{ item.label }}（{{ item.count ?? 0 }}）</template>
	</AsamTabs>
	<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">当前 {{ active }}；变更 {{ changes }} 次</p>
	<AsamTabs
		:model-value="pane"
		@update:model-value="
			(value) => {
				if (typeof value === 'string') pane = value;
			}
		"
	>
		<AsamTabPane label="概览" name="overview">
			<p class="example-paragraph">概览内容</p>
		</AsamTabPane>
		<AsamTabPane label="明细" name="detail" lazy>
			<p class="example-paragraph">延迟挂载的明细</p>
		</AsamTabPane>
		<AsamTabPane label="暂不可用" name="disabled" disabled />
	</AsamTabs>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTabsBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTabs, AsamTabPane } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTabItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const active = ref('all');
const pane = ref('overview');
const changes = ref(0);
const items: AsamTabItem[] = [
	{ label: '全部', value: 'all', count: 3 },
	{ label: '草稿', value: 'draft', count: 1 },
	{ label: '锁定', value: 'locked', disabled: true }
];
</script>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

Sizes ​

Tab height and font size are 50px and 20px for large, 40px and 16px for default, 32px and 14px for small, and 28px and 12px for mini.

Usage guidelines ​

ASAM adds the label, value, disabled, and count fields on items. The label slot receives the item. See the full notes.

Complete examples ​

Basic usage ​

Switch between panes using the default tab style.

Use v-model or model-value to control the selected pane's name. Use default-value to choose the initial pane when the selection is uncontrolled. The default name of the first pane is the string "0". Set an initial selection explicitly if you assign custom names. In the data-driven API, value belongs to an individual item.

Use tab-position to place the tab strip.

The supported positions are left, right, top, and bottom.

Adding and closing tabs ​

The default, card, and border-card styles all support adding and closing tabs. Use editable, or set addable and closable individually, to show the relevant controls. The tabAdd, tabRemove, and edit events report the action. The host updates the pane data and maintains the current selection.

Example: cap-dynamic-tabs

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamTabs
		:model-value="editableTabsValue"
		type="card"
		editable
		class="demo-tabs"
		@update:model-value="
			(value) => {
				if (typeof value === 'string') editableTabsValue = value;
			}
		"
		@edit="handleTabsEdit"
	>
		<AsamTabPane
			v-for="item in editableTabs"
			:key="item.name"
			:label="item.title"
			:name="item.name"
		>
			{{ item.content }}
		</AsamTabPane>
	</AsamTabs>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTabsCapDynamicTabsDemo' });
import { AsamTabs, AsamTabPane } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTabsTabPaneName } from '@asam-ui/ui';

let tabIndex = 2;
const editableTabsValue = ref('2');
const editableTabs = ref([
	{
		title: '标签页一',
		name: '1',
		content: 'Tab 1 content'
	},
	{
		title: '标签页二',
		name: '2',
		content: '标签页二的内容'
	}
]);

const handleTabsEdit = (targetName: AsamTabsTabPaneName | undefined, action: 'remove' | 'add') => {
	if (action === 'add') {
		const newTabName = `${++tabIndex}`;
		editableTabs.value.push({
			title: '新标签页',
			name: newTabName,
			content: '新标签页内容'
		});
		editableTabsValue.value = newTabName;
	} else if (action === 'remove') {
		const tabs = editableTabs.value;
		let activeName = editableTabsValue.value;
		if (activeName === targetName) {
			tabs.forEach((tab, index) => {
				if (tab.name === targetName) {
					const nextTab = tabs[index + 1] || tabs[index - 1];
					if (nextTab) {
						activeName = nextTab.name;
					}
				}
			});
		}

		editableTabsValue.value = activeName;
		editableTabs.value = tabs.filter((tab) => tab.name !== targetName);
	}
};
</script>

<style>
/* stylelint-disable selector-class-pattern -- Base-component BEM selectors are required for this demonstration. */

Touch, keyboard, and nested instances ​

In a narrow container, swipe along the tab strip to reach the last tab. Swiping perpendicular to the strip still scrolls the page. Keyboard navigation skips disabled tabs. tabNavRef exposes scrollToActiveTab, focusActiveTab, removeFocus, tabListRef, and tabBarRef. Read ref and call update through tabBarRef.

Example: behavior

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="selectLast">
				选择末项
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="active = '1'">
				选择首项
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				@click="position = position === 'top' ? 'left' : 'top'"
			>
				{{ position === 'top' ? '切换为左侧标签' : '切换为顶部标签' }}
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="inspect">
				调用嵌套实例
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<AsamTabs
			ref="tabs"
			:model-value="active"
			:tab-position="position"
			class="touch-tabs"
			@update:model-value="
				(value) => {
					if (typeof value === 'string') active = value;
				}
			"
		>
			<AsamTabPane
				v-for="i in 24"
				:key="i"
				:name="String(i)"
				:label="'标签 ' + i"
				:disabled="i === 2"
			>
				正文 {{ i }}
			</AsamTabPane>
		</AsamTabs>
		<output v-bind="domDataAttrs('data-state', 'active')">{{ active }}</output>
		<output v-bind="domDataAttrs('data-state', 'nested')">{{ result }}</output>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTabsBehaviorDemo' });
import { nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTabs, AsamTabPane } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTabsExpose, AsamTabsProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const active = ref('1');
const position = ref<AsamTabsProps['tabPosition']>('top');
const tabs = ref<AsamTabsExpose>();
const result = ref('');
async function selectLast() {
	active.value = '24';
	await nextTick();
	await tabs.value?.tabNavRef?.scrollToActiveTab();
}
const inspect = async () => {
	const nav = tabs.value?.tabNavRef;
	await nav?.scrollToActiveTab();
	await nav?.focusActiveTab();
	nav?.removeFocus();
	nav?.tabBarRef?.update();
	result.value = nav?.tabListRef && nav?.tabBarRef?.ref ? 'nested-ready' : 'not-mounted';
};

type DemoDataAttributes = Record<`data-${string}`, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;
const domDataAttrs = (
	name: `data-${string}`,
	value: string | number | boolean | null | undefined = ''
): Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'class'> & DemoDataAttributes => ({
	class: 'ui032-data-marker',
	[name]: value
});
</script>
<style scoped>
.touch-tabs {
	width: min(100%, 320px);
	height: 240px;
}

.controls {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

.controls > :deep(.asam-button + .asam-button) {
	margin-inline-start: 0;
}
</style>

<style scoped>
.demo-root-layout {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	width: 100%;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	justify-items: start;
}

.demo-root-layout > :is(p, pre, output) {
	margin-block: 0;
}
</style>

Each tab uses the width token as its minimum width and grows to fit its full label, count, and close button. The underlying navigation scrolls to accommodate longer labels. The close button follows the underlying hover behavior and has room to remain clickable.

Additional usage and API notes ​

Usage guidelines ​

ASAM adds the label, value, disabled, and count fields on items, and the label slot receives the item. Place AsamTabPane in the default slot to render pane content. Use distinct names across both forms. v-model accepts strings or numbers, and change includes the data item. The underlying tabClick, tabChange, edit, tabAdd, and tabRemove events remain available. See the public API for type, tabPosition, editable, closable, beforeLeave, and other props. Disabled items cannot be selected and are skipped during keyboard navigation. Accessibility attributes follow the underlying tabs implementation.

API reference

Type AsamTabValue

Type AsamTabItem

NameDescriptionTypeDefault

value—AsamTabValue—
disabled—boolean | undefined—
count—number | undefined—

$route parameters and event data

The following is a readable declaration view. Use the public type definition for importable types. Branch conditions follow the parent property.

  • $route.matched: (NonNullable<AsamTabsTabBarInstance["$route"]>)["matched"] — Dependency declaration

    Array of {@link RouteLocationMatched} containing only plain components (any lazy-loaded components have been loaded and were replaced inside the `components` object) so it can be directly used to display routes. It cannot contain redirect records either. **This property is non-enumerable**.

    Nested expansion boundary: Framework / platform type; see the public type definition for the full type.

  • $route.name: (NonNullable<AsamTabsTabBarInstance["$route"]>)["name"] — Dependency declaration

    Name of the matched record

  • $route.fullPath: string — Dependency declaration

    The whole location including the `search` and `hash`. This string is percentage encoded.

  • $route.query: (NonNullable<AsamTabsTabBarInstance["$route"]>)["query"] — Dependency declaration

    Object representation of the `search` property of the current location.

  • $route.hash: string — Dependency declaration

    Hash of the current location. If present, starts with a `#`.

  • $route.redirectedFrom: (NonNullable<AsamTabsTabBarInstance["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"] — Dependency declaration

    Contains the location we were initially trying to access before ending up on the current location.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.matched: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTabsTabBarInstance["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "matched"> — Dependency declaration

      Array of {@link RouteRecord} containing components as they were passed when adding records. It can also contain redirect records. This can't be used directly. **This property is non-enumerable**.

      Nested expansion boundary: Framework / platform type; see the public type definition for the full type.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.fullPath: string — Dependency declaration
